description: This file contains unit tests for Deep Links security within the OpenClawKit project. It tests URL parsing and validation logic for secure and insecure deep link configurations, specifically focusing on WebSocket and gateway URLs, including setup code scenarios.

classes.name: DeepLinksSecurityTests
classes.description: A test suite containing multiple test cases related to deep links security validation.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkRejectsInsecureNonLoopbackWs
methods.description: Tests that a non-loopback WebSocket URL with insecure settings is rejected.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkRejectsInsecurePrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Tests that URLs with insecure host bypass attempts are rejected.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkAllowsLoopbackWs
methods.description: Tests that a secure WebSocket URL pointing to localhost is accepted.

methods.name: setupCodeRejectsInsecureNonLoopbackWs
methods.description: Tests that setup codes with non-loopback WebSocket URLs are rejected.

methods.name: setupCodeRejectsInsecurePrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Tests that setup codes with insecure host bypass are rejected.

methods.name: setupCodeAllowsLoopbackWs
methods.description: Tests that setup codes with localhost WebSocket URLs are accepted.
